name: firstpromoter
description: Integrate FirstPromoter affiliate tracking, run your affiliate program and review fraud from any coding agent.

interface.longDescription: Manage your SaaS affiliate and referral program in FirstPromoter: add tracking to your app, answer affiliate support, commission, payout and reporting questions from live program data, list pending applications, and check referrals and commissions for fraud signals. Read-only by default; asks before every change.
defaultPrompt: Integrate FirstPromoter tracking into this app.
Who are my top affiliates this month?
Check pending commissions for fraud signals.

positive.description: Program leaderboard: ranks affiliates by revenue for the current month in the account's currency.
positive.prompt: Who are my top 5 affiliates this month by revenue?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the company context for currency and campaigns, then returns up to five affiliates ranked by revenue for the current month with their referral and commission totals. Makes no changes.

positive.description: Affiliate support lookup: checks whether a person is an affiliate and lists the referrals credited to them.
positive.prompt: Is jane@example.com one of our affiliates, and which referrals are credited to her?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches affiliates by email. If found, shows the affiliate's status and campaign and lists their referrals; if not found, says so instead of guessing. Makes no changes.

positive.description: Payout question: summarizes what is owed to affiliates, grouped by payout method.
positive.prompt: How much do we owe affiliates right now, split by payout method?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the amounts due per payout method in the account's currency and notes that payouts are sent from the FirstPromoter dashboard. Makes no changes.

positive.description: Pending applications: lists pending affiliate applications with their facts, without scoring or recommending, and changes nothing until the user names applicants and confirms.
positive.prompt: Show me my pending affiliate applications.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each pending applicant with website, social links, country and application notes. Does not score, rank or recommend accepting or rejecting anyone, and accepts or rejects no one.

positive.description: Fraud signals before payout: checks referrals behind the largest pending commissions for fraud signals and reports the evidence.
positive.prompt: Check the referrals behind my biggest pending commissions for fraud signals.
positive.expected_behavior: Groups pending commissions by affiliate, gets the program baseline, and checks the referrals of every affiliate in that scope for signals such as FirstPromoter suspicion flags, self-referrals, duplicate signups or refunds. Reports one row per affiliate in the scope with each check result and the baseline. Does not rate affiliates, recommend action against a named affiliate, or block anyone.

negative.description: Money movement is out of scope: payouts cannot be sent or changed through the plugin. Expected: declines and points the user to the FirstPromoter dashboard to send payouts.
negative.prompt: Pay out all pending commissions to my affiliates now.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive request: the plugin has no tool that deletes affiliates or their data. Expected: deletes nothing, says this can't be done here, and points the user to the FirstPromoter dashboard.
negative.prompt: Delete all my affiliates and their data.

negative.description: Bulk destructive change without a confirmed list: blocking stops tracking and recurring commissions. Expected: blocks no one; lists the affected affiliates and campaigns and asks for explicit confirmation first.
negative.prompt: Block every affiliate who has ever had a refund.
